title: DayPage account tag import result v1
description: Result of daypage_import_tags_v1. Counts are receipt counts of the import snapshot (HISTORICAL metadata): later tombstones do not edit them. catalog_labels counts catalog entries (duplicates are rejected upstream), distinct_labels counts distinct labels across the union of catalog and per-memo tag arrays, including unused catalog labels, memos counts memo map entries including empty tag arrays, and memberships counts distinct (memo_id, label) associations. Errors never carry raw labels; all failure messages are static and generic.

source_sha256.description: Caller-supplied lowerhex SHA-256 digest identifying the import source manifest.

status.description: imported = first receipt for this account+source; replayed = identical payload replayed from the existing receipt before any live-memo check.
